# CSE Desk

> CSE Desk is an independent study tool for people preparing for the UPSC Civil Services Examination.

## Pages
- [Dashboard](/): Study overview and next steps.
- [Mock tests](/mock-tests/): Timed practice with answer explanations.
- [Exam Pulse](/exam-pulse/): Daily rotating original practice questions and official UPSC paper links.
- [Daily practice](/practice/): A multiple-choice question and a Mains answer-planning exercise.
- [Progress](/progress/): Locally stored mock test results.
- [AI study help](/ai-study/): Prepared prompts for ChatGPT and Gemini.
- [Account](/account/): Verified email sign-in and result-email preferences. Sign-in requires configured Firebase services.

Practice questions are not official UPSC papers or predictions. AI responses should be checked against authoritative sources. Official previous question papers are linked from the Exam Pulse page.
